01 / LONG-DISTANCE EXPLORER

The jet airliner

Connecting the world

Swept wings and jet engines make fast, high-altitude travel possible. A pressurized cabin keeps passengers comfortable along the way.

Propulsion
Jet engines
Typical role
Long-distance passenger travel
Explore this aircraft ↗
02 / EVERYDAY ADVENTURER

The propeller plane

Small runways. Big adventures.

Propellers turn engine power into thrust. These versatile aircraft serve everything from flying lessons to remote communities.

Propulsion
Propeller engine
Typical role
Training and regional flying
Explore this aircraft ↗
03 / SILENT SKY SEEKER

The sailplane

The art of soaring

Long, slender wings help gliders travel efficiently. Pilots seek rising air to stay aloft, often without an engine.

Propulsion
Unpowered soaring
Typical role
Sport and recreation
Explore this aircraft ↗
04 / HEAVY LIFTER

The cargo plane

Freight across the horizon

Designed to carry goods instead of a passenger cabin. Large cargo doors and dedicated loading spaces help move supplies, equipment, and everyday essentials.

Propulsion
Jet engines
Typical role
Freight and logistics
Explore this aircraft ↗
05 / VERTICAL EXPLORER

The helicopter

Hover. Lift. Land.

Rotating blades provide lift, allowing helicopters to hover and take off vertically. They support rescue missions, transport, and access to hard-to-reach places.

Propulsion
Powered rotors
Typical role
Rescue and vertical flight
Explore this aircraft ↗
06 / WATERWAY WANDERER

The seaplane

Where water becomes a runway

Floats or a boat-shaped hull let seaplanes take off and land on water. Amphibious designs also have landing gear for land-based runways.

Propulsion
Propeller engine
Typical role
Water-based operations
